summary: GCI Liberty, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a Securities Purchase Agreement on April 21, 2026, whereby its wholly owned subsidiary GCI Holdings, LLC will acquire all equity interests in Q Gateway Intermediate Holdings, LLC (Quintillion) from Q Gateway Ultimate Holdings, LLC. Total consideration includes $310M cash at closing (subject to working capital adjustments), up to $50M in reimbursed capex within 30 days post-close, and earn-out payments for 2027/2028/2030 gross revenues payable in 2028/2029/2031. GCI may satisfy the 2030 earn-out in Series C stock valued by VWAP. Closing is subject to customary conditions and regulatory approvals. Watch for antitrust review timeline; earn-out structure adds revenue-linked upside.
